paragraphs: EnvisionWare builds self-service systems that public libraries put in front of their patrons. The company frames the goal as enriching what a library offers the public inside the building and beyond it.

On the patron side, that covers scanning, copying and faxing at the point of service. Payment handling, ecommerce services and other self-service options fill out the rest of the line. Feedback runs straight to the top, with customers given a direct link to the entire management and executive team.

The company was formed almost 25 years ago around a single purpose and says it has kept to it since. It counts customers at over 10,000 libraries worldwide. Its stated commitment is that every library, regardless of size, gets the same level of customer service and support.

quote.text: Great libraries want to expand services to the public, offer new programs, provide higher levels of service
